name: a suggested work counts as a linked work
why: _rowHasRecordingOfWork() takes any /work/ link again: once suggestions are in, the 🚫 no-work count drops from 4 to 1.
grep: loads each artist's work list once

name: suggestions are written to the live cells only
why: _wsugCellIndex() leaves out the source rows: the next filter re-render clones rows that never had the suggestion.

name: an artist shared by several tracks is asked again
why: The per-pass artist list is no longer de-duplicated. Known overlap: the loop's "list already in memory" check skips the second occurrence, so no extra request is made and the spec cannot see it.
grep: loads each artist's work list once

name: a list already in memory is asked again
why: The loop no longer skips an artist whose list is in memory. Known overlap: _recOfLoadArtistWorks() then answers from IndexedDB (artist-works), so the cost is one IndexedDB read, not a request, and no spec can see it from the network log.
grep: a failed work list marks only

name: a cell with a work becomes a target
why: _wsugRowTarget() stops checking for a linked work: every row gets a 💡 and its work is overwritten.

name: a failed list reads as "no close title"
why: The failure branch is gone: a track whose only candidate list failed is shown as – (answered) instead of ⚠ (retry).
grep: a failed work list marks only

name: a single-cell click loads every track
why: The click delegate drops `only`: one 💡 click looks up all four tracks.
grep: a 💡 cell loads only its own track

name: suggestions are saved to disk
why: getCleanCellHtml() keeps ul.mb-wsug-list: a disk load shows stale suggestions and the cells are no longer pending.

name: the match note is text
why: The pill writes its note as text: a filter for "exact title" matches rows and the cell text is no longer just the suggestion.
grep: loads each artist's work list once

name: the setting does not gate the feature
why: _wsugOn() ignores sa_release_tracks_work_suggest: switched off, the toggle and 💡 cells still appear.
